assertions.expectation: Left activation shows the non-activating toolbar; bidirectional navigation wraps; release inserts exactly the selected accent.
Right activation shows the non-activating toolbar; bidirectional navigation wraps; release inserts exactly the selected accent.
Space activates and advances, wrapping last to first.
Shift+Space moves backward, wrapping first to last; release commits once without stuck Shift.
Disabled Quick Accent does not activate or insert accents.
Both arrows activate in Arrows mode; Space passes through.
Space activates in Space mode; both arrows pass through.
All three triggers activate in Either mode; the selected mode persists after revisiting Settings.
Below/above 300 ms observations distinguish false starts and sustained activation; Space and both arrow false starts retain normal behavior.
Below/above 900 ms observations distinguish false starts and sustained activation; Space and both arrow false starts retain normal behavior.
Rapid canceled gestures leave no stale popup or stuck-letter behavior in subsequent typing.
At 500 ms configuration, quick tap, sustained hold, unselected release, navigation and selected release behave as specified.
At 1000 ms configuration, quick tap, sustained hold, unselected release, navigation and selected release behave as specified.
Pre-threshold Space, Left, Right and a different supported letter independently cancel without delayed appearance or replacing intervening text; fresh activation succeeds.
Ctrl+A remains a normal shortcut without activating the toolbar.
Visible and pending gestures cancel on transfer to an owned different process without accent insertion; fresh activation succeeds.

assertions.condition: Two owned text HWNDs in the same process
assertions.expectation: Visible and pending gestures cancel on transfer to a different same-process HWND without accent insertion.
Currency alone has no A mapping and has S currency mappings.
French E accents and a non-French mapping are accessible with All available; selection persists.
Filtering retains hidden selections; Cancel discards draft changes and Save commits; zero-selection Save is disabled.
Verify every Currency row probe and insert its specified P character.
Verify and insert the Icelandic I row.
Verify and insert all four Pitjantjatjara row mappings.
Verify and insert both Belarusian U variants independently.
Verify I correction, Euro and quote mappings; insert one stated character for each key.
Verify and insert Greek Euro, Hebrew Shekel and Vietnamese Dong independently.
Verify Greek polytonic A row and insert a stated character.
Verify and insert inverted exclamation/question marks for Spanish and Catalan; record layout/Shift.
Verify every Special matrix key/character and ordering condition; insert a stated character for each key.
Verify every IPA matrix key/character; insert a stated character for each key.
Verify German comma quotes without math substitutions and insert a quote.
Usage ordering follows controlled increments relative to preserved counters and visible list.
Disabling sorting restores normal language order; original usage history is restored after the run.
With start-from-left on, both arrows select the first item and commit that item.
With start-from-left off, Left/Right select their middle-adjacent initial items and commit those items.
All nine named positions match active work-area geometry without clipping; retain each row's observation.
All nine positions work on the second active monitor without scaling/placement drift.
Short-list cells and last highlight remain visible without unnecessary scrolling.
Single-code-point and U+00B0 U+0043 descriptions correspond to selection; short-list cells remain visible.
With descriptions off, scrollbar appears for overflow only; both edge selections scroll into view with painted highlights and selected insertion.
With descriptions on, scrollbar appears for overflow only; both edge selections scroll into view with painted highlights and selected insertion.
Recorded first-visible frames for alternating lists have current, nonblank, unclipped content; record capture cadence.
Both themes render legibly without losing selection or activation.

assertions.condition: Existing RTL locale and fractional DPI
assertions.expectation: Edge selection and layout remain correct in the additional RTL/scaling condition.
Owned excluded Notepad suppresses activation while a separate unexcluded owned process still activates.
Removing only the added exclusion restores Notepad activation and preserves prior exclusions.
Prevention enabled does not block the ordinary non-game text fixture.
Prevention on suppresses activation in game mode; prevention off permits it.

assertions.condition: Disposable authorized Keyboard Manager remap and downstream observer
assertions.expectation: False-start owner key-up reaches downstream and the remap still executes.

assertions.condition: Disposable authorized centralized shortcut and input observer
assertions.expectation: Quick Accent replacement/arrow injections do not retrigger unrelated shortcuts.
Guide opens with selected sets first and others alphabetically within language/special groups; return restores originating Settings surface.
Single-character and multi-code-point queries retain only matching sets, keeping all mappings inside them; no-match and cleared queries show empty/restored content.
Hover shows the correct Unicode description; combining marks have dotted-circle display aid.

assertions.condition: Clipboard formats supported by preservation guard
assertions.expectation: Click copies exact ordinary character and restores private baseline.

assertions.condition: Clipboard formats supported by preservation guard
assertions.expectation: Click copies underlying combining mark without dotted circle and restores private baseline.
At smaller/larger supported sizes all character-set selection/search/Save/Cancel controls remain reachable.

assertions.condition: Existing non-English Windows/app locale with shipped translations
assertions.expectation: Module Settings/set/attribution labels use available translations and preserve proper names.
